source_title: Hong Kong Sixes 2026: Krunal Pandya to lead India, check full squads - Sportstar
source_excerpt: The Hong Kong Sixes will feature 12 teams competing in 25 matches over three days at Mission Road Ground, Mong Kok. Hong Kong will face Australia in the opening match. The teams are divided into four groups: Australia, Hong Kong and England (A); Bangladesh, Scotland and Sri Lanka (B); India, Pakistan and the UAE (C); and Afghanistan, South Africa and Oman (D). The group winners will advance to the semifinals. India will be led by Krunal Pandya, while defending champion Pakistan will be captained by Abbas Afridi. John Simpson will lead England, with Chris Green at the helm of Australia. Matches will follow a six-a-side, six-overs-per-innings format, with every player except the wicketkeeper required to bowl.
